answer: The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the whisper funding graph is rebuilt from the pulse history every epoch. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 16 bonds yet holds one position, and the fable report publishes the merged exposure. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 16 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
